objective: Speak with Overlord Mok'Morokk in Brackenwall Village.

description: Stonemaul Village was invaded by the brood of Onyxia. But why would the daughter of the black dragonlord, Deathwing, descend upon our lands?
This is most troubling. Surely, Onyxia was driven here for a purpose beyond laying siege to a small band of ogres.
Notify Mok'Morokk at once! Action must be taken.
completion: Why you tell me 'bout dragons? Me no like dragons. Me like it here. No dragons here.
